h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Malda

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Malda

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Malda

c: Malda is known across India for its mangoes, and its orchards and river plains shape much of the district. English Bazar, the main town, has schools, colleges, government offices and a growing number of apartment buildings. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Malda for all of these. We make every machine at our Vasai factory, about 1690 km away.

Equipment comes by road to north Bengal and is installed by our team or a dealer in eastern India. Malda sits between the Ganga and the Mahananda, and the monsoon months can bring flooding to low ground. We plan every outdoor gym on a raised, well-drained base. Summers are hot and humid and winters are short and cool, so a site with some shade from existing trees works through the year.

items.q: What if our ground in Malda floods during the monsoon?
items.a: Choose the highest part of the site and build a raised concrete base. After the water goes down, check bolts and moving parts and clear silt from the footings before use.

items.q: Can government offices in Malda order outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. We prepare a layout drawing and a detailed quote that your department can review. After approval we manufacture, dispatch and install through our team or a regional dealer.

items.q: How many people can use a set of three machines at once?
items.a: It depends on the models. Single machines take one person and double machines take two. Tell us how many people come at peak time and we will plan around it.
